evidence_quotes.quote: Each 40 g sachet contains 25 g of carbohydrates (100 kcal) in a 0.8:1 ratio of fructose to glucose; box of 12 servings (480 g net).
Six natural ingredients: Water, Glucose, Fructose, Calcium Carbonate, Gluconic Acid, Sodium Alginate; 20 mg sodium (~50 mg salt equivalent), 0 g fat, 0 g protein.
Maurten Gel 100 batches are tested and certified under the Informed Sport anti-doping assurance program.
